name: Control Shadows
body:
School transmutation [darkness, shadow]; Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area one 5-ft. cube of shadow/level
Duration Concentration + 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You can shift and alter existing darkness and shadow, whether natural or magical. You can cause one of the following effects:

Deepen: The darkness becomes darker lowering the light level by 1, if the darkness is already darkness, it becomes supernatural darkness as per the spell deeper darkness.
Lighten: The darkness becomes one level lighter, if the darkness was supernaturally dark like from deeper darkness it becomes standard darkness rather than becoming dim light.
Move: The affected darkness can be moved anywhere within the spell’s range, however if you move out of the range of the source of the darkness, it returns to its original position.

You can only have one effect operating at a time but you can switch between them as a free action once per round. The chosen effect covers the entire affected area.

When the spell expires all shadows and darkness reverts to their original light levels and locations.
